title: Setup: mutually exclusive user actions are offered together whatever the record's state (Ban with Unban, Revoke with Restore)
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-11** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Actual:** an unbanned user offers both *Ban User* and *Unban User* (record header and row menu); an active API key offers *Revoke* and *Restore*, a revoked one the same; *Unlock Account* on an account that is not locked answers "Account unlocked". (OAuth Applications does it right: Disable / Enable switch with the state.)
- **Evidence:** [`07-F-users-record-ban-and-unban.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/07-F-users-record-ban-and-unban.png), [`07-people-users-row-menu.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/07-people-users-row-menu.png), [`17-access-api-keys-list.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/17-access-api-keys-list.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** every admin.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `plugin-auth` action declarations (`ban_user`/`unban_user`, `revoke_api_key`/`restore_api_key` lack a `visible` condition).
- **Dedupe words:** ban and unban both shown, revoke restore both shown, action visibility state.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** `packages/platform-objects`. Each action's `visible` checks only `isPlatformAdmin`, not the record's state.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 0 hits in objectstack, 1 in objectui, not on point. **New.**
